# SIM uncle

> SIM uncle is a Hong Kong-based eSIM provider offering instant global eSIM data plans for 200+ countries and regions. No SIM card swap needed — scan a QR code and connect immediately.

## About SIM uncle

SIM uncle (simuncle.com) sells eSIM data plans for international travellers. All plans are instant digital delivery via QR code. Pricing is in Hong Kong Dollars (HKD). Customer support is available in Cantonese, Mandarin, and English.

- **Website**: https://simuncle.com
- **Also known as**: eSIM Uncle, esimuncle.com
- **Founded**: 2024
- **Headquarters**: Hong Kong
- **Contact**: WhatsApp +852-9888-5159

## Products & Services

SIM uncle offers eSIM data plans for:
- Single-country plans (Japan, South Korea, Thailand, Singapore, USA, UK, Australia, Taiwan, and 190+ more)
- Regional plans (Europe 33 countries, Asia, Americas, Middle East, Africa, Oceania)
- Short-term plans (1–7 days) and long-term plans (up to 365 days)
- Unlimited data plans and fixed-data plans (1GB to 100GB+)
- Top-up (add-on) plans for extending data on existing eSIMs

All plans support 4G LTE; select plans support 5G networks.

## How eSIM Works

1. Purchase a plan on simuncle.com
2. Receive a QR code by email instantly
3. Go to phone Settings > Mobile Data > Add eSIM
4. Scan the QR code — done

Compatible devices include iPhone XS and later, Samsung Galaxy S20 and later, Google Pixel 3 and later, and most modern Android phones with eSIM support.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is an eSIM?**
An eSIM (embedded SIM) is a digital SIM card built into your device. You activate it by scanning a QR code — no physical SIM swap needed.

**Which devices support eSIM?**
Most modern smartphones: iPhone XS+, Samsung Galaxy S20+, Google Pixel 3+, and many other Android devices.

**How quickly do I receive my eSIM?**
Instantly after payment — the QR code is delivered to your email within seconds.

**Can I use eSIM and my local SIM at the same time?**
Yes. Most dual-SIM phones let you keep your local SIM for calls while using the eSIM for data abroad.

**What currency does SIM uncle use?**
All prices are in Hong Kong Dollars (HKD).

**Does SIM uncle offer customer support?**
Yes, via WhatsApp at +852-9888-5159, available in Cantonese, Mandarin, and English.
